sections.0.items.1.text: Ferry, scooter and room, all sorted
sections.0.items.2.text:
從台東搭船到綠島，碼頭有人接，機車和背包客房都準備好。
你只要選想怎麼玩：浮潛、體驗潛水，或已經有證照的 Fun Dive 都可以！

Take the ferry from Taitung to Green Island; we'll meet you at the harbor with your scooter and backpacker room ready.
All you choose is how to play: snorkeling, Discover Scuba, or Fun Dive if you're certified!

sections.2.items.12.text: 基本套裝＋浮潛行程 1 次。不用會潛水，戴面鏡就能看珊瑚和魚。
Basic package + 1 snorkeling trip. No diving needed: just put on a mask to see the coral and fish.
sections.2.items.13.text: 基本套裝＋體驗水肺潛水 1 次。沒有證照、沒潛過也可以。
Basic package + 1 Discover Scuba dive. No certification or experience needed.
sections.2.items.14.text: 基本套裝＋船潛 2 支、岸潛 2 支，含裝備租用。
Basic package + 2 boat dives and 2 shore dives, gear rental included.

sections.3.items.1.text: 建議行程。下水時間依海況和潮汐安排，出發前我們會盡快跟你確認。
Suggested itinerary. Dive times depend on sea conditions and tides; we'll confirm with you before you leave.
sections.3.items.3.text: 台東富岡漁港搭船約 50 分鐘到綠島，碼頭接送到綠芙。放好行李後騎機車環島。
Ferry from Fugang Harbor, Taitung to Green Island (about 50 min); we'll pick you up at the harbor. Drop your bags, then ride around the island.
sections.3.items.5.text: 依你選的套裝下水：浮潛、體驗潛水或 Fun Dive。其他時間自由活動。
Get in the water with your package: snorkeling, Discover Scuba or Fun Dive. The rest of the day is yours.
sections.3.items.7.text: 早上自由活動，還機車後碼頭接送，搭船回台東。
Free morning. Return the scooter, we'll take you to the harbor, and you ferry back to Taitung.
sections.4.items.1.text: 訂套裝時可以一起加，金額是新台幣、每人價格。
Add them when you book a package. Prices in NT$, per person.
